name: ShareAsQR
tagline: A lightweight app for QR code generation from text or sharing from other apps.
blurb: ShareAsQR is a lightweight Android app designed to make generating QR codes as simple and efficient as possible.
description:
ShareAsQR is a lightweight Android app designed to make generating QR codes
as simple and efficient as possible. Unlike other apps, ShareAsQR focuses
solely on QR code generation, keeping the app small and fast.

Features:

* QR Code Generation
* Sharing generated QR images
